What goes on a UK VAT invoice

HMRC lists what a full VAT invoice must show. The main items are:

  • A unique invoice number that follows on from the last one
  • Your business name, address and VAT registration number
  • The invoice date, and the time of supply (tax point) if it is different
  • Your customer's name and address
  • A description of what you supplied, with quantity and price before VAT
  • The VAT rate, the total before VAT and the total VAT

How to fill it in here

Enter your VAT number in Tax ID and set the tax name to VAT. The number then prints as "VAT no." on the invoice. Keep the automatic numbering, and set the rate to 20% or the rate you charge.

Tallyslip applies one VAT rate to the whole invoice. If lines have different rates, or the tax point differs from the invoice date, note it in Notes and check HMRC's guidance on VAT invoices. This page is general information, not tax advice.

Not VAT registered?

Only VAT-registered businesses can charge VAT. If you are not registered, set the tax rate to 0 and leave out a VAT number.

Questions

Is this invoice generator really free?

Yes. Make and download as many invoices, quotes, estimates and receipts as you like. Pro is a one-time upgrade that adds your logo, brand color, unlimited saved documents and CSV export.

Do I need an account?

No. There is no sign-up. Your documents are saved in this browser, on this device.

Where is my data stored?

Only in your browser's local storage. Nothing you type is sent to a server, and the PDF is generated on your device. Clearing your browser data deletes your saved documents, so keep the PDFs you send.

Can I invoice in my own currency and language format?

Choose from 46 currencies. Numbers and dates follow your browser's language settings, so a German browser shows 1.234,50 € and a US browser shows $1,234.50.

What should an invoice include?

Your name and contact details, your client's name, a unique invoice number, the issue date and due date, a line for each item or service with quantity and price, any tax, the total due, and how to pay you. Some countries also require your tax ID. Check your local rules.

My client's name uses non-Latin letters. Will the PDF work?

The PDF supports Latin, Greek and Cyrillic alphabets and most currency symbols. For other scripts, use Print and choose “Save as PDF”, which uses your device's own fonts.
